steps.description:
Show that your robot can display the following order:
1. Display the text "Scissors Paper Stone" at centre of the LCD screen for 2 seconds

Hint:
1. Set Display type to On for Second
2. Set Row and Column

The program plays continuously until the stop Button on the blockly interface is clicked.

Show that your robot can perform the following with one button:
1. Display the text "Scissors Paper Stone" at centre of the LCD screen for 2 seconds
2. Display the text "Press To Start" at the top center row of the LCD screen until Button is pressed and hold.
3. When Button is pressed, clear LCD Screen

Hint:
1. Set Display type to On for Second
2. Set Row and Column

The program plays continuously until the stop Button on the blockly interface is clicked.

Show that your robot can perform the following with one button:
1. Display the text "Scissors Paper Stone" at centre of the LCD screen for 2 seconds
2. Display the text "Press To Start" at the top center row of the LCD screen until Button is pressed and hold.
3. Display the text "Bot Vs Player" at top center of the LCD screen
4. When Button A is pressed, display the text "Scissors" at the bottom right corner of the LCD screen
5. Display Step 3 to 4 for 2 seconds

Hint:
1. Set Display type to On for Second
2. Set Row and Column

The program plays continuously until the stop Button on the blockly interface is clicked.

Show that your robot can perform the following with two buttons:
1. Display the text "Scissors Paper Stone" at centre of the LCD screen for 2 seconds
2. Display the text "Press To Start" at the top center row of the LCD screen until Button A or B are pressed and hold.
3. Display the text "Bot Vs Player" at top center of the LCD screen
4. When Button A is pressed, display the text "Scissors" at the bottom right corner of the LCD screen
5. When Button B is pressed, display the text "Paper" at the bottom right corner of the LCD screen
6. Display Steps 3 to 5 for 2 seconds

Hint:
1. Set Display type to On for Second
2. Set Row and Column

The program plays continuously until the stop Button on the blockly interface is clicked.

4. When Button A is pressed, display the text "Scissors" at the bottom right corner of the LCD screen
5. When Button B is pressed, display the text "Paper" at the bottom right corner of the LCD screen
6. When Button A and B are pressed, display the text "Stone" at the bottom right corner of the LCD screen
7. Display Steps 3 to 6 for 2 seconds

4. When Button A is pressed, display the text "Scissors" at the bottom right corner of the LCD screen
5. When Button B is pressed, display the text "Paper" at the bottom right corner of the LCD screen
6. When Button A and B are pressed, display the text "Stone" at the bottom right corner of the LCD screen
7. Display Step 3 to 6 for 2 seconds
8. Create a variable named bot
9. Assign a random number from 1 to 3 to variable bot
10. Display the variable bot on the LCD screen for 2 seconds

Show that your robot can perform the following with two buttons:

2. Display the text "Press To Start" at the top center row of the LCD screen until Button A or B are pressed and hold.

6. When Button A and B are pressed, display the text "Stone" at the bottom right corner of the LCD screen
7. Create a variable named bot
8. Assign a random number from 1 to 3 to variable bot
9. If the chosen random number is 1, display the text "Scissors" at the bottom left corner of the LCD screen
10. If the chosen random number is 2, display the text "Paper" at the bottom left corner of the LCD screen
11. If the chosen random number is 3, display the text "Stone" at the bottom left corner of the LCD screen
12. Display steps 3 to 11 for 3 seconds
